_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THUG1 level ports (tools/thug1_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-30...). Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33). The other THUG1 levels are named by THUG1's own Levels.qb (Load_NJ...) - THUG1 data, no entry. Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thug1_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out.
